name: Valentina Carrasco
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, restoring vintage cars with her father in their Santiago workshop. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for intricate mechanics and precision engineering. She honed her skills through apprenticeships at local racing teams, eventually finding her niche as a fabricator. Valentina’s meticulous approach to her work ensures that every component meets the highest standards, contributing to the team's overall performance. Her ability to adapt to changing requirements and tight deadlines makes her an invaluable asset to ART Grand Prix Academy.

She's known for her innovative solutions to complex problems, often devising creative workarounds that save time and resources. While demanding of herself and others, Valentina fosters a collaborative environment, always willing to share her knowledge and mentor younger team members. Her unwavering commitment to excellence and her ability to remain calm under pressure set her apart, earning her the respect of her peers and drivers alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave.
physical.description: A sturdy woman with kind eyes and hands that show years of skilled work.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn wrench in her pocket.
Insists on cleaning her workspace meticulously before and after each task.
Humming quietly while focused on intricate fabrication, usually traditional Chilean folk songs.
